Find applicable evidence-backed ways to reduce execution time in this GitHub Actions workflow. Consider its jobs, dependencies, commands, triggers, and repository manifests.
name: CI

on:
  push:
    branches:
      - main
  pull_request: {}

# Cancel a pull request's earlier runs when a new commit supersedes them.
#
# `head_ref` is set only for pull_request events, so a PR groups by its branch
# and a new push cancels the run for the commit it replaced. For a push to
# main the fallback is `run_id`, which is unique per run, so those never share
# a group: they are neither cancelled nor made to queue behind each other.
#
# Without this, every push queued another full matrix and the superseded runs
# kept their place in line. With a scarce runner pool that is how the queue
# fills with work for commits nobody is waiting on any more.
concurrency:
  group: ${{ github.workflow }}-${{ github.head_ref || github.run_id }}
  cancel-in-progress: true

jobs:
  check-format:
    runs-on: ubuntu-22.04
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v7
        with:
          submodules: true

      # Use nightly Rust to check the format
      - uses: dtolnay/rust-toolchain@stable
        with:
          toolchain: nightly
          components: rustfmt, clippy
      - uses: Swatinem/rust-cache@v2
        with:
          cache-bin: false
      - name: Check format
        run: cargo fmt --all -- --check

  check-rust-sdk:
    needs:
      - check-format
    strategy:
      fail-fast: true
      matrix:
        os: [ubuntu-22.04, windows-latest, macos-latest]
    runs-on: ${{ matrix.os }}
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v7
        with:
          submodules: true

      - name: Install Rust
        uses: dtolnay/rust-toolchain@stable
        with:
          toolchain: stable
          components: rustfmt, clippy
      - uses: Swatinem/rust-cache@v2
        with:
          cache-bin: false

      - name: Check with clippy
        run: |
          cargo clippy -p longbridge --all-features
          cargo clippy -p longbridge-oauth --all-features --all-targets -- -D warnings

      - name: Test
        run: |
          cargo test -p longbridge --all-features
          cargo test -p longbridge-oauth --all-features

  check-python-sdk:
    needs:
      - check-format
    strategy:
      fail-fast: true
      matrix:
        os: [ubuntu-22.04, windows-latest, macos-latest]
        python-version: ["3.8", "3.9", "3.10", "3.11", "3.12", "3.13", "3.14"]
    runs-on: ${{ matrix.os }}
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v7
        with:
          submodules: true

      - name: Install Python
        uses: actions/setup-python@v7
        with:
          python-version: ${{ matrix.python-version }}

      - name: Install Rust
        uses: dtolnay/rust-toolchain@stable
        with:
          toolchain: stable
          components: rustfmt, clippy
      - uses: Swatinem/rust-cache@v2
        with:
          cache-bin: false

      - name: Check with clippy
        run: cargo clippy -p longbridge-python --all-features

      - name: Build wheels
        uses: PyO3/maturin-action@v1
        with:
          manylinux: auto
          args: -i python${{ matrix.python-version }} --out dist -m python/Cargo.toml
      - name: Install built wheel
        run: |
          pip install longbridge --no-index --find-links dist --force-reinstall
          python -c "import longbridge"

  check-python-sdk-musl:
    needs:
      - check-format
    strategy:
      fail-fast: true
      matrix:
        target: [x86_64-unknown-linux-musl, aarch64-unknown-linux-musl]
        python-version: ["3.8", "3.9", "3.10", "3.11", "3.12", "3.13", "3.14"]
